subject: computer-science
title: Binary Numbers: Addition
welcome_lead: Two plus two in binary? It's 100 — and we'll show why.
meta_desc: KS3 binary: column addition, carries, simple sums.
final_note: Binary maths follows the same rules as denary, just with smaller digits.

concepts.def: A 1 moved to the next column when sum > 1.
A carry past the available bits.
A circuit that does binary addition.

walkthroughs.body_html: Add 0101 (5) + 0011 (3). Right column 1+1=10: write 0 carry 1. Next 0+1+1=10: write 0 carry 1. Next 1+0+1=10: write 0 carry 1. Last 0+0+1=1. Answer 1000 (8).
If your answer needs more bits than you have, the leftmost carry is lost — that's overflow. It causes bugs in real computers.
